description: Paste text to get reading and speaking time estimates plus a Flesch Reading Ease score.

faqs.a: Syllables are estimated with a vowel-group heuristic ("beautiful" = 3). It is fast and usually close, but a real dictionary lookup would be exact — so scores are estimates.
Reading time assumes 200 words per minute (average silent reading) and speaking time assumes 130 words per minute (average speech pace).
No. All analysis runs locally in your browser; nothing is sent to a server.

howto: Paste or type your text into the text area.
See words, characters, sentences and estimated syllables.
Read the reading/speaking time estimates and the Flesch Reading Ease score with its grade label.
title: Reading Time Calculator
